paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.4, with a change of -3.03% from the prior close and 2.4% over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of August 14, 2026.

Recent news headlines include Fermi receiving a US subpoena tied to Project Matador, securing a $6.5B AI lease and $431M notes, and analysts offering insights on the company. Construction is also underway at Fermi America's Project Matador Campus in Texas.

There have been various SEC filings, including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer. Insider activity includes one Form 4 filing.
